field.name: attributeHandle
field.comment: What is displayed: the handle of a page attribute, or rpv_ followed by the name of a property of the page (rpv_pageName, rpv_pageDescription, rpv_pageDateCreated and so on)

field.name: attributeTitleText
field.comment: The text displayed before the value (empty: none)

field.name: displayTag
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the value, without the angle brackets (empty: the value is not wrapped)

field.name: dateFormat
field.comment: A format accepted by the date() PHP function, used when the value is a date

field.name: thumbnailHeight
field.comment: The height of the thumbnail, in pixels, used when the value is an image (0 or NULL: the width decides)

field.name: thumbnailWidth
field.comment: The width of the thumbnail, in pixels, used when the value is an image (0 or NULL: the height decides)

field.name: delimiter
field.comment: The text separating the items, used when the value holds more than one (for instance a topics attribute)
